text: This is the Keeper’s Island. One lighthouse, two hundred people, and a lamp that has not missed a night in thirty years.
Gus keeps the lamp. Mabel, his cat, keeps an eye on Gus.
And Rollo, the mouse, keeps an eye on the sandwiches.
Dunn runs the harbour. Old Wren knows every old story. Marlo pilots the ferry. And Pip, the gull, sees everything.
And someone in a yellow coat has started coming up out of the sea.
